_readme: THE MODEL'S ENTRY — locked, versioned, committed. Regenerate only by running
scripts/build-model-picks.ts by hand. Never at build time: the point is that
these picks were fixed before kickoff like everyone else's.
Every pick carries a `tier` saying how much to trust it:
modelled  straight from the Elo season simulation (team outcomes)
projected a player projection from two prior seasons of production
derived   a projection plus a rule of thumb (awards)
market    no statistical basis; the price the Form's dropdown carried

nfc_west.basis: highest division-title probability across 10,000 season replays

afc_south.basis: highest division-title probability across 10,000 season replays

afc_west.basis: highest division-title probability across 10,000 season replays

afc_east.basis: highest division-title probability across 10,000 season replays

nfc_east.basis: highest division-title probability across 10,000 season replays

nfc_north.basis: highest division-title probability across 10,000 season replays

afc_north.basis: highest division-title probability across 10,000 season replays

nfc_south.basis: highest division-title probability across 10,000 season replays

pass_yards.basis: projected 4968 yards — highest in the league from two prior seasons weighted 70/30 toward 2025, scaled by SEA's projected 12.3 wins

rush_yards.basis: projected 1799 yards — highest in the league from two prior seasons weighted 70/30 toward 2025, scaled by BAL's projected 9.6 wins

rec_yards.basis: projected 1933 yards — highest in the league from two prior seasons weighted 70/30 toward 2025, scaled by LA's projected 10.3 wins

sacks.basis: projected 23 sacks — highest in the league from two prior seasons weighted 70/30 toward 2025, scaled by LA's projected 10.3 wins

mvp.basis: top projected passer weighted by title odds — 4968 yards on a 15% Super Bowl team

opoy.basis: most projected yards from scrimmage by a non-quarterback (2174)

sb_mvp.basis: starting quarterback of the projected Super Bowl champion

dark_horse.basis: best projected passer outside the six title favourites (4922 yards)

coy.basis: New York Giants projected +3.0 wins on last season, the biggest gain in the league

first_fired.basis: coaches the lowest-projected team in the league (5.3 wins)

first_benched.basis: last season's starter on the lowest-projected team

oroy.basis: shortest price in the Form's own dropdown (+550)

droy.basis: the option the Form marked as favourite

cpoy.basis: the option the Form marked as favourite

abstentions.sb_points: the season simulation produces win probabilities, not scores
